scope: AI-assisted static source review; one reviewer per case evaluates three answers with condition labels hidden and randomly reassigned A/B/C. Self references may reveal tools.
timing: All source/binary/runner inputs frozen before measured sessions; review did not tune the measured tool.
limits: Reviewers are AI agents familiar with prototype/data preparation, not independent human raters.
No external project code/tests executed; no verified repairs.
Labels assess the main explanation and material errors, not every detail or exact prediction range.
Malformed JSON can still have a source-supported explanation; parser/location metrics remain separate.
